paper.title: Large Language Monkeys : Scaling Inference Compute with Repeated Sampling

result.summary: 本文研究将推理计算作为新的扩展维度，通过重复采样提升语言模型在推理任务上的表现 [S1.p3]。作者在五个任务上生成大量独立样本，发现覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上增长，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p1]。在具有自动验证器的编码和形式证明任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升，例如 SWE-bench Lite 上从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56% [S1.p8]。但在缺乏自动验证器的数学应用题中，多数投票和奖励模型等常见选择方法在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，无法充分利用覆盖率增长 [S4.SS1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样在多种任务、模型和样本预算下带来的收益，探索推理计算作为扩展轴 [S1.p3]。其动机在于，尽管训练计算扩展持续提升模型能力，但推理时用户和开发者通常只允许模型对一个问题进行一次尝试 [S1.p2]。重复采样的有效性取决于两个关键属性：覆盖率（随样本数增加能解决多少问题）和精确率（能否从样本集合中识别正确样本）[S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.
However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.

1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?

method.text: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，以正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，然后使用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试）从样本中选择最终答案 [S1.F1]。覆盖率定义为至少一个生成样本能解决的问题比例，在编码任务中等价于 pass@k 指标，并使用无偏估计公式计算 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。对于没有自动验证器的任务，论文测试了多数投票、奖励模型最佳选择（Best-of-N）和奖励模型加权多数投票三种验证方法 [S4.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
pass@k $\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\text{\# of problems}}\sum_{i=1}^{\text{\# of problems}}\left(1-\frac{\binom{N-C_{i}}{k}}{\binom{N}{k}}\right)$

1. Majority Vote: We pick the most common final answer. 2. Reward Model + Best-of-N: We use a reward model to score each solution, and pick the answer from the highest-scoring sample. 3. Reward Model + Majority Vote: We calculate a majority vote where each sample is weighted by its reward model score.

experiments.text: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 数学应用题（各 128 个随机测试问题）、MiniF2F-MATH 形式化证明（130 个问题）、CodeContests 竞赛编程（140 个问题）和 SWE-bench Lite 真实 GitHub 问题 [S2.p4]。主要使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct，对前四个任务每个问题生成 10,000 个独立样本；SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架，每个问题限制 250 次尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。此外还评估了 Gemma 和 Pythia 系列模型（70M 到 70B 参数）在 MATH 和 CodeContests 上的表现 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: 1. GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set. 2. MATH: Another dataset of math word problems that are generally harder than those from GSM8K. Similarly, we evaluate on 128 random problems from this dataset’s test set. 3. MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset. 4. CodeContests: A dataset of competitive programming problems. Each problem has a text description, along with a set of input-output test cases (hidden from the model) that can be used to verify the correctness of a candidate solution. We enforce that models write their solutions using Python3. 5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.

We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem. For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.
To minimize costs, we restrict the number of attempts per issue to 250, with all attempts made independently of one another.
• Llama 3: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Llama-3-70B-Instruct. • Gemma: Gemma-2B, Gemma-7B. • Pythia: Pythia-70M through Pythia-12B (eight models in total).
We restrict evaluation to the MATH and CodeContests datasets to minimize inference costs, reporting results in Figure 3.

findings.text: 覆盖率随样本数增加而平滑提升，在多个任务和模型上均成立；例如 Gemma-2B 在 CodeContests 上从 pass@1 的 0.02% 提升到 pass@10k 的 7.1%，Pythia-160M 在 MATH 上从 0.27% 提升到 57% [S2.SS2.p3]。在具有自动验证器的任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升：SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过单样本 SOTA 的 43% [S1.p8]。覆盖率与样本数的关系常可用指数幂律建模，且同一模型家族的覆盖率曲线在水平平移后形状相似 [S3.p2]。然而，在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上，多数投票和奖励模型等验证方法在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，无法达到覆盖率上界 [S4.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: On CodeContests, the coverage of Gemma-2B increases by over 300x, from a pass@1 of 0.02% to a pass@10k of 7.1%. Similarly, when solving MATH problems with Pythia-160M, coverage increases from a pass@1 of 0.27% to a pass@10k of 57%.

When restricted to a single sample, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct solves only 15.9% of issues. By simply increasing the number of samples to 250, we increase the fraction of solved issues to 56%, exceeding the state-of-the-art by 13%.

1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law. 2. For a given task, the coverage curves of different models from the same family resemble S-curves with similar slopes but distinct horizontal offsets.

While success rates initially increase with the number of samples for all three methods, they plateau around 100 samples. Meanwhile, coverage continues to increase with the number of samples and eventually exceeds 95%.

limitations.text: 作者指出，实验仅探索了简单版本的重复采样，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，并认为该设置可通过增加解多样性、多轮交互和从先前尝试中学习来改进 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。此外，在缺乏自动验证器的领域，常见验证方法（多数投票和奖励模型）无法随样本预算扩展，需要改进样本验证方法 [S5.p5]。论文还发现 SWE-bench Lite 中 11.3% 的问题存在不稳定测试，CodeContests 中存在假阴性测试用例，这些验证器缺陷会影响重复采样的效果 [S4.SS2.SSS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: In our experiments, we explore only a simple version of repeated sampling where all attempts to a problem are generated independently of one another using the exact same prompt and hyperparameters.

1. Solution Diversity: We currently rely on a positive sampling temperature as the sole mechanism for creating diversity among samples. Combining this token-level sampling with other, higher-level approaches may be able to further increase diversity. 2. Multi-Turn Interactions: Despite automatic verification tools being available when solving CodeContests and MiniF2F problems, we use only a single-turn setup where models generate a solution without any ability to iterate on it. 3. Learning From Previous Attempts: Currently, our experiments fully isolate attempts from each other.
Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
When producing our results on SWE-bench Lite, we identified that 11.3% of problems have flaky test suites that do not produce consistent results when running them on the same candidate solution.
However, the construction of the CodeContests test suites leads to false negative solutions that are correct but fail the tests.
